archive.catalogue_description: Description This is version v1.1. It fixes several bugs and glitches. Fixes: 1. You can’t get outside the map (as far as I know). 2. You can’t walk through the stove upstairs. 3. The browning now has sound. 4. You can’t walk on the ledge behind the hole upstairs. Story background: Welcome aboard marines. Your task today is to investigate some mysterious happenings at a local compound. You will take the train from here and find out what is going on. If all goes well you should be back having dinner with your families tonight, if not… Well, I wish you the best of luck. Semper Fi. Story real-time: Marine 1: Man this train sure is noisy.
